primary_source_citation.title: Vehicular Cycling Lane Positioning & Hand Signal Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Ride with traffic, stay 3 to 4 feet clear of parked car doors, and take the full lane when too narrow to share safely.
core_mechanism_bullets: Ride with traffic, stay 3 to 4 feet clear of parked car doors, and take the full lane when too narrow to share safely.
Scan behind before merging, give left, right, and stop hand signals 100 feet before turns, and obey all traffic signals.
